scheme_name: Gems & Jewellery Sector PLI – Design Innovation Grant
overview: The Gems & Jewellery Sector PLI – Design Innovation Grant is a scheme under the Production Linked Incentive (PLI) framework aimed at boosting design innovation in the gems and jewellery sector. It provides financial incentives to manufacturers based on incremental sales of value-added products, encouraging domestic value addition and reducing import dependence. The scheme supports the development of a competitive domestic supply chain and promotes innovation-driven manufacturing in the sector.
objectives: Boost domestic manufacturing and value addition in the gems and jewellery sector
Encourage design innovation and development of high-value products
Reduce import dependence by promoting local production
Create employment opportunities in the sector
Strengthen the domestic supply chain through incentivized investment
Support MSMEs and startups in adopting advanced design and manufacturing practices
eligibility: Manufacturers of gems and jewellery products who are registered under the Companies Act, 2013 or as a partnership firm, and who undertake incremental investment in eligible product categories with a focus on design innovation and value addition, are eligible to apply under the scheme.
benefits: Financial incentives based on incremental sales of eligible products, support for design innovation, technical assistance for upgrading manufacturing capabilities, and facilitation of market access for value-added gems and jewellery products.
financial_support: The scheme provides a subsidy of 4–6% on incremental sales of eligible gems and jewellery products over a base year, as part of the Production Linked Incentive (PLI) mechanism, to encourage investment in design-led manufacturing and value addition.
application_process: 1. Register on the official PLI portal for the Gems & Jewellery sector. 2. Submit application with details of incremental investment and production capacity. 3. Provide documentation including Certificate of Incorporation, GST details, and product specifications. 4. Await evaluation by the Project Management Agency. 5. Upon approval, sign agreement and begin production to claim incentives based on incremental sales.
required_documents: Product specifications and design innovation plan
Undertaking of compliance with scheme guidelines
implementing_agency: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry
caveats: Incentives are disbursed only after verification of incremental sales
Only value-added products with design innovation qualify for benefits
Claims are subject to audit and compliance verification
